Research pages are point-in-time evaluations of candidate inputs. Revalidate upstream state, licensing, security, and maintenance before acting on an older recommendation.

| Assessment | Date | Current recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| [Smol Machines Sandbox](./assessments/smol-machines.qmd) | 2026-08-26 | Keep local `smolvm` available as an experimental, opt-in Advisory Profile with required target-host boundary tests; keep it out of defaults and automatic advice. |
| [Stagehand and Playwright](./assessments/stagehand-playwright.qmd) | 2026-08-12 | Retain Playwright; consider Stagehand only as an opt-in complement for bounded model-assisted browser workflows. |
| [Diagram Design](./assessments/diagram-design.qmd) | 2026-08-10 | Keep under consideration as opt-in external Design Profile guidance; do not vendor yet. |
| [Ix Code Map](./assessments/ix-code-map.qmd) | 2026-08-10 | Keep as a research candidate; do not add as a dependency, default profile, or vendored skill. |
| [Writing Style Skills](./assessments/writing-style-skills.qmd) | 2026-08-03 | Consider a reviewed SimpleEnglish adaptation; defer Economist Style pending evaluation and provenance review. |

When a candidate is adopted or definitively rejected, record the durable outcome in the owning registry, plan, or ADR and retire the assessment if it no longer provides useful rationale.
